Game Overview

Alone In The Evil Mansion is a horror title where explore the spine-chilling depths of a haunted mansion, where survival hinges on strategic resource management and unraveling sinister secrets. Navigate atmospheric environments with classic tank controls as fear lurks in every shadow, capturing the essence of '90s survival horror. Will you escape the terrors within?
